parameters.prompt: The exact upright white tiger warrior in the reference performs ONE charge in place. From the resting pose it crouches low, lowers the head and leans forward with both clawed hands held low, one foot scraping back to gather power; then it bursts into a low forward-leaning sprint pose and runs fast in place with the legs alternating quickly, the arms pumping, the head lowered toward the left; then it skids to a stop, straightens and calmly returns to the exact original standing pose and holds it. It stays at the same spot and size and does not move across the frame. Exactly two arms and two legs. Fixed camera, fixed size, pure uniform bright green #00FF00 background. The whole character stays inside the frame with clear margins at all times. Keep the same three-quarter left view, white tiger head, white and black striped fur, silver hair, armor, belt and kilt. No jump, walking, turning, extra limbs, weapon, glow, energy, magic effects, dust, rocks, cracks, particles, shadow or text. Motion beats: crouch and gather over the first second, run in place from about one and a half to three and a half seconds, then stop and hold the original pose.
